name: Blueprint Biosecurity
summary: A Washington, DC nonprofit, founded in 2023, that works on pathogen-agnostic defences against pandemics: far-UVC light and other ways to clean indoor air (glycol vapours, upper-room germicidal light, filtration) and pandemic-grade reusable respirators, through research syntheses (its 'Blueprints'), research grants to universities and, since 2025, work with Congress and federal agencies.

spending.source: https://apps.irs.gov/pub/epostcard/990/xml/2025/2025_TEOS_XML_11A.zip (Form 990 for 2024, IRS e-file object 202503189349311100, Part IX line 25 (B): programme services $2,398,911 of total expenses $3,095,622, calendar year 2024; audited statements)
